theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (v : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (δ : ℝ) (k : Fin (m + 1)), ContDiff ℝ 1 v → 0 ≤ δ → δ < 1 / 2 → ∫ x in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, |v (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => if j < k then y j else x j)) - v (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => if j ≤ k then y j else x j))| ≤ (1 - 2 * δ) * (volume {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}).toReal * ∫ x in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < y i ∧ y i < 1 - δ}, |fderiv ℝ v x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)|
